A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices A–Q. Content can be matched reliably despite formatting and pagination changes.

before.justification: v2 reports original channel analyses, causal interventions, ablations, weight-steering experiments, and analyses across training checkpoints and seeds.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the intervention scores, supplementary case studies, and checkpoint and seed analyses.

M1.justification: The DRC(3,3) architecture, channel-discovery and intervention procedures, encoder simplification, planning mechanisms, and weight-steering procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain Boxoban unfiltered, medium, and hard coverage and the same custom Sokoban scenarios, including enlarged boards, zig-zag paths, backtracking, and competing routes.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the box-movement and agent-movement probe comparators. Table 10 retains DRC(1,1) and ResNet alongside DRC(3,3), and Appendix E retains the base-feature-only regression comparison.

E3.justification: Documented settings remain unchanged, including 900,000 training levels, two billion training steps, 10,000 causal-intervention transitions, the 512-level backtracking analysis, and Table 10's comparison with zero or six thinking steps.

E4.justification: The cache and gate ablations, WTA and backtracking interventions, longer-route case study, weight-steering failure analysis, and checkpoint and cross-seed analyses are all retained with the same evidence.

E5.justification: Both retain the same uncertainty reporting, including Appendix I's 95% confidence intervals, and the same analysis of the principal network plus four additional training seeds. No run-count disclosure or statistical procedure changes.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 retains PNA intervention success of 99.7±0.2%, and Table 10 retains identical solve rates. Figure 10's channel-identifier edit is a presentation correction.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(13), including the encoder combination, ConvLSTM updates, gate-ablation approximations, and normalized WTA score, are mathematically unchanged. No assumptions, proofs, or derivations are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions concerning path channels, transition-model components, bidirectional planning, and backtracking. Section 5's claim about agentic mesa-optimization is also retained.

C2.justification: Both retain the value-function interpretation and qualifications, the explanation of shorter-path preference, and the limitations of weight steering. Appendix P retains the same scope restrictions and unexplained box-switching and heuristic behaviors.

D1.justification: Architecture, training, preprocessing, offset estimation, automated-labeling thresholds, and larger-board action-probe details are unchanged. No code or data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix O retain the same cited works and positioning relative to probing, circuit analysis, and planning research. Bibliographic differences concern formatting rather than citation membership or scientific positioning.

P1.justification: v3 updates publication and author text, heading capitalization, citation style, and cross-reference wording. The prose, narrative sequence, and appendix organization are otherwise retained; apparent paragraph moves largely reflect pagination.

P2.justification: v3 adopts ICLR headers and title formatting and reflows text and long tables. Figure 10 changes the box-right label from L1H17 to L0H17, while Figure 11 is displayed smaller. The figure and table inventory remains unchanged.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, evidence, and limitations are unchanged. Presentation changes have limited tradeoffs: Figure 10 removes one incorrect identifier but its caption still names L1H13, while Figure 11 becomes smaller. These edits leave overall paper quality meaningfully unchanged.
